defect: The unconstrained external request may be paced and data held by its producer. The RTL does not establish that contract; an unacknowledged toggle is unsafe for back-to-back events but can be valid for spaced events.

mutation.description: The sender toggles and overwrites data_hold on every request instead of rejecting or queueing a request until the receiver acknowledges it.

labels.note: Unacknowledged event toggle and payload capture need a minimum request-spacing/hold contract, absent here. Consecutive requests are unsafe, but external pacing could make this topology valid.
